reasoning: Both sets come from the same planning method and both are thorough. They differ in where they are strong. B has the richer RL design. Its learning ladder (tabular, then DQN, then a CNN, plus ablations; REINFORCE, then PPO; three self-play rungs with cross-play) teaches more. Its golden cases are concrete and correct: I checked the Q-update, GAE, clipped objective, reflection and catch-distance numbers by hand. B's structure is weaker. Each stage is one very large milestone: M1 alone has 31 tasks covering tabular, DQN, CNN, ablations, the library reference, replay and the report. So there is no walking skeleton, and nothing runs end to end until most of the stage is built. B also has stale framing. The roadmap promises S2 'on a deliberately revised shared core', and the spec keeps CORE-06 'after the core's interface revision', but AD-09 builds the batch-first core in M1. The brief says 'Not doing: designing future environments now' while the spec fully designs both later stages, and its success section covers only Snake. B also weakens the user's success bar: the compact DQN only has to be 'not worse than scripted'. Finally, PL-01 is a 16-step table that mixes in predator-prey baselines and the opponent pool, so it no longer reads as one call path. A follows the user's ground truth more closely: every world must beat both baselines, a write-up is required per world, and the user's 'each fish sees only nearby things' is kept. A also splits the stages into 7 vertical milestones along real dependency lines: one fish, then many fish, then local sight. Its M1 is a true skeleton with a baseline spine (online Q-learning, a REINFORCE-flavoured PPO). Its pipelines are short and easy to sketch from, and its CLI only dispatches. A's weaknesses: M3 'Check and explain the snake' looks like a leftover milestone, and M2 pairs DQN tuning with the replay viewer. The tests doc is weaker and has unresolved items: TC-07's direction and TC-17's bound, and TC-17 is an M1 golden case. Some spine packets also leave out a type they need. On balance, A's milestone design, clarity and consistency outweigh B's greater RL depth.
